newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Miel says owns 65.85 pct of Transmarco.
newsitem.headline: Miel says owns 65.85 pct of Transmarco.

text.p: Miel Investment Corporation owns 18.11 million or 65.85 percent of Transmarco's total issued and paid up share capital after its unconditional takeover offer of the trading and telecommunications firm expired on Thursday.

A joint statement by Standard Chartered Merchant Bank Asia Ltd and Swiss Bank Corporation on behalf of Miel said holders of 23,010 shares, representing 0.08 percent of Transmarco shares, had accepted its takeover offer.

Miel, whose sole director is Jonathan Sampoerna, son of Indonesian tobacco tycoon, Putera Sampoerna, owned 18.09 million shares, representing 65.77 percent before making the offer for the remaining shares.
